title: How OpenAI uses ChatGPT Sites (live at DevDay!) | Kath Korevec (Product Lead)
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (36 mins) | 🎙️ Kath Korevec demos ChatGPT Sites live at OpenAI DevDay, showing how to turn Slack, Notion, and calendar data into internal tools that adapt to each person on your team
summary: Kath Korevec is a member of the Product staff at OpenAI working on Codex, and she spent over a year building and using ChatGPT Sites internally before its public launch. She’s been on the front lines of shipping Plugin Insights, MCP plugin hosting, and the connector ecosystem, which now includes around 60 integrations.
